title: DNA-Binding and Cytotoxicity of Copper(I) Complexes Containing Functionalized Dipyridylphenazine Ligands.
authors: Alsaedi, Sammar; Babgi, Bandar A; Abdellattif, Magda H; Arshad, Muhammad N; Emwas, Abdul-Hamid M; Jaremko, Mariusz; Humphrey, Mark G; Asiri, Abdullah M; Hussien, Mostafa A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜(I)-dppz配合物与DNA的结合及细胞毒性，涉及分子对接但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: A set of copper(I) coordination compounds with general formula [CuBr(PPh(3))(dppz-R)] (dppz-R = dipyrido[3,2-a:2',3'-c]phenazine (Cu-1), 11-nitrodipyrido[3,2-a:2',3'-c]phenazine (Cu-2), 11-cyanodipyrido[3,2-a:2',3'-c]phenazine (Cu-3), dipyrido[3,2-a:2',3'-c]phenazine-11-phenone (Cu-4), 11,12-dimethyldipyrido[3,2-a:2',3'-c]phenazine (Cu-5)) have been prepared and characterized by elemental analysis, (1)H-NMR and (31)P-NMR spectroscopies as well as mass spectrometry. The structure of Cu-1 was confirmed by X-ray crystallography. The effect of incorporating different functional groups on the dppz ligand on the binding into CT-DNA was evaluated by absorption spectroscopy, fluorescence quenching of EtBr-DNA adducts, and viscosity measurements. The functional groups affected the binding modes and hence the strength of binding affinities, as suggested by the changes in the relative viscosity. The differences in the quenching constants (K(sv)) obtained from the fluorescence quenching assay highlight the importance of the functional groups in altering the binding sites on the DNA. The molecular docking data support the DNA-binding studies, with the sites and mode of interactions against B-DNA changing with the different functional groups. Evaluation of the anticancer activities of the five copper compounds against two different cancer cell lines (M-14 and MCF-7) indicated the importance of the functional groups on the dppz ligand on the anticancer activities. Among the five copper complexes, the cyano-containing complex (Cu-3) has the best anticancer activities.
abstract_zh: 一系列通式为[CuBr(P(Ph)3)(dppz-R)]的铜(I)配位化合物（其中dppz-R = 二吡啶并[3,2-a:2',3'-c]吩嗪 (Cu-1)、11-硝基二吡啶并[3,2-a:2',3'-c]吩嗪 (Cu-2)、11-氰基二吡啶并[3,2-a:2',3'-c]吩嗪 (Cu-3)、二吡啶并[3,2-a:2',3'-c]吩嗪-11-苯酮 (Cu-4)、11,12-二甲基二吡啶并[3,2-a:2',3'-c]吩嗪 (Cu-5)）已被制备，并通过元素分析、1H-NMR和31P-NMR光谱以及质谱法进行了表征。Cu-1的结构通过X射线晶体学确认。通过吸收光谱、EtBr-DNA加合物的荧光猝灭以及粘度测量，评估了在dppz配体上引入不同官能团对CT-DNA结合的影响。官能团影响了结合模式，从而影响了结合亲和力的强度，这由相对粘度的变化所提示。从荧光猝灭测定中获得的猝灭常数（K(sv)）的差异，突显了官能团在改变DNA上结合位点方面的重要性。分子对接数据支持DNA结合研究，其中与B-DNA相互作用的位点和模式随不同官能团而变化。对五种铜化合物针对两种不同癌细胞系（M-14和MCF-7）的抗癌活性评估表明，dppz配体上的官能团对抗癌活性具有重要性。在五种铜配合物中，含氰基的配合物（Cu-3）具有最佳的抗癌活性。
